details.message: Update check completed for site 73 (Zero Waist Solutions). Found 7 plugin updates available and WordPress core is up to date.

Could not complete plugin updates for site id=73 (Zero Waste Solutions). update-all-plugins-tool initially rejected the request with "No recent backups found. Please run a full backup before proceeding." I then called create-backup-tool (backup_type=full), which queued job_id=job_5d69a437f7ac5220 under batch_id=batch_031afa4cc577fc40 (scheduled 2026-09-07 05:48:52, started 05:48:56). I polled check-batch-status-tool repeatedly (with check_directly_on_site=true) over more than 10 minutes of elapsed wall-clock time, and the backup job remained in "running" status the entire time (0 completed, 0 failed) — it never reached a terminal state within the monitoring window. Because a completed backup is a hard prerequisite for update-all-plugins-tool, I did not proceed with the plugin update (7 plugins were pending per the earlier update check) to avoid updating without a verified backup in place. Recommended next step: continue polling batch_031afa4cc577fc40 (or job_5d69a437f7ac5220) until it reaches a terminal state (success/failed/cancelled), then retry update-all-plugins-tool with id=73, create_backup=true, run_health_checks=true. If the backup remains stuck in "running" beyond a reasonable window, investigate directly on the site (large full backups can be slow, or the job may be stalled).
